verdict.rationale: Adyen claims platform risk tooling to "identify fraudulent behavior, stop suspicious payouts, and flag unusual user activities" [docs-4]. It also lets platforms outsource user risk management or configure their own monitoring rules and mitigations [docs-18], and funds can be held until payout [docs-2]. However, the evidence is high-level overview copy without detailed risk-feature documentation, and offboarding is only implied by account deactivation/closure webhooks [docs-32]. Missing for 10: explicit credit-risk signals per sub-merchant, a portfolio-wide risk view or dashboard, documented alerting mechanics for anomalous sellers, a documented payout-pause or offboarding workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
